Very Disappointing Experience The driver accepts the booking and then demands extra money. When we refuse, the driver does not cancel the ride and still expects payment. This has happened to me 4–5 times, and the same thing has also happened with my sister. This is extremely frustrating and completely defeats the purpose of having a booking app. Uber should take responsibility for such drivers and provide a proper solution instead of making customers suffer.
